coverage_note: Medi's Arabic is transcribed as [speaking foreign language]/[speaking Arabic] 33 times, mostly 14:11-14:47, 16:21-24:07 (the whole 'apologize' translation drill) and 33:03-34:01; in those stretches only Amal's fixes/chat show what he said. From 27:46 to the end (1:03:44) his Arabic is Latin-transliterated by the engine, often garbled (e.g. 'sijal', 'behtr', 'mata kharab po', 'Glesh'), so 'wrong' strings there are the engine's spelling. 09:13 Amal asks 'متى؟' and types 'talaate u rube3' but his time answer is not in the transcript. Skipped as S4/S5: 'ما تارات' for ma66arat (41:29), 'خربات' for 5erbat (41:14), 'سرابته' (44:20), 'بيصلع' restart (43:23), self-fixes 'سبعتين'->'سبعتاش' (08:32), 'يوم السب--'->'يوم الخميس' (09:00), 'نفس الجو اليوم'->'نفس جو اليوم' (09:44). 05:32-05:41 he asked whether 'they put' should be past; she said present (rule answer, not an error). 55:11 'bidahik/bizahik' mix-up was self-fixed before her 'Bizahiq'.
